complete_source_units.text: He will take holiness as an invincible shield,
Terrifying rulers will fear me when they hear of me; among the multitude I will appear good, and in war courageous.
or newly created, unknown beasts full of fury, either breathing a fire-breathing blast, or scattering a stench of smoke, or flashing dreadful sparks from their eyes,
whose injury could not only utterly crush them, but whose very appearance could terrify and destroy them.
Then, strengthened over time, the ungodly custom was kept as law.
For this man knows better than everyone that he is sinning, when he crafts fragile vessels and carved images from earthy material.
For not even the recess that held them kept them free from fear; terrifying sounds rang around them, and gloomy specters with unsmiling faces appeared.
Then at once apparitions of dreadful dreams disturbed them, and unexpected fears came upon them;
For the dreams that troubled them had announced this beforehand, so that they would not perish without knowing why they suffered.
